MWI Animal Health | Remote (US only) | Senior SWE, Senior DevOps

US animal-health distributor. We build .NET/Angular apps and hardware UIs that talk to our APIs.

1. Senior Software Engineer Full-stack C#/ASP.NET Core, Node/Angular; backend services and device integrations. 7+ years, strong .NET. Nice: AWS, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Docker/K8s; Linux networking on hardware (firewall/ssh).

2. Senior DevOps Engineer Shared CI/CD, Docker/K8s, broader infra and team tooling. Labeled DevOps; may lean generalist/infra over time. 7+ years, AWS or Azure, Linux networking.

Email Alex.Heck (at) cencora (dot) com
